hero.sub: Bid for the next track of the night and follow the auction to the second. If it does not play, you get everything back.

scan.title: Scan the QR on the floor.
scan.body: Open it on your phone. Nothing to install, no sign-up and no password.

choose.title: Pick the track and bid.
choose.body: Auctions run all night. The amount to beat and the time left are shown before you pay.

decide.title: The DJ decides.
decide.body: Nothing plays unless it is accepted. If it does not play, the money comes back to you on its own.

guest.label: Guests
guest.title: or less to shape the sound of the night.
guest.body: Nothing to install, no sign-up and a guaranteed refund.

dj.label: DJs
dj.title: You have the last word.
dj.body: Extra revenue, live demand and total artistic control.

venue.label: Venues
venue.title: No new hardware.
venue.body: More revenue per guest, more engagement and data from the night.

guarantee.title: If it does not play,
guarantee.body: Full, automatic refund. If someone outbids you, your money goes straight back to your balance.
